title: Agent Hooks — host declaration refusal classes
description: The closed set of declaration_error:* classes a loader reports when it refuses a host declaration document (AGENT-HOOKS-0.1 §7.7.6). A refusal is a construction error, never a verdict: no emitter exists yet, so there is no record or §11 reason to carry it. Classes are listed in pipeline order; a loader reports exactly one class per document, the first step that fails.

classes.cause: The path is not a regular file, exceeds 1 MiB, is not strict UTF-8, starts with a byte-order mark, or an I/O error occurred.
The text is not one JSON object, holds a duplicate key, nests deeper than 32 levels, exceeds 1 MiB, or (value path) carries a non-finite number.
declaration is missing, not a string, or not in the loader's accepted set (§7.7.2). The error names the accepted set.
spec is present with another wire major, a minor above the loader's, or a malformed value.
An unknown member at any closed level of the document.
A member has the wrong type, a value outside its closed set, a pattern or range violation, or breaks a required-iff rule.

An internal consistency rule failed: the §3.2 floor, the omission pairs, a knob the profile does not consult, a composition outside the declared surface, incremental_output without buffered_output: false, the document's own version missing from its accepted set, a binding at a point outside the surface, or a duplicate binding id.
The surface or configuration names a point, capability, profile, knob value, contract version, posture, unbuffered output or numeric timeout the host's code cannot honour.
The identity provider, approval resolver or approval redactor the document names is not registered.
A binding names a kind with no registered resolver.
A kind resolver returned an error, raised, panicked, or returned something that is not an interceptor.
